legal_form: קרן פתוחה, קרן מחקה (open tracking fund under the Joint Investment Trust Law 1994; bought and redeemed at the unit price through a distributor, not traded on the exchange, ETF-04); קרן בלתי מוגבלת בניירות ערך חוץ; exposure profile 4D. Trustee: אלמגור-בריטמן נאמנויות בע"מ. Tracking asset on Maya's fund page: NASDAQ 100 - NTR 100% + דולר ארה"ב 100%. Payment policy on Maya: 'לא מתחייבת לחלק תשלומים'. REPLICATION: futures and swaps: mainly futures abroad on the tracking asset and swaps on it, with FX forwards and spot (annual report p. 2, 'הדרך שבה הקרן תנוהל': 'ניהול השקעות הקרן מתאפיין בעיקר בביצוע עסקאות בחוזים עתידיים בחו"ל על נכס המעקב, בעסקאות החלף על נכס המעקב ועיסקאות חוזי אקדמה וספוט על מט"ח'). Size used to rank the fund (not a fee input): net assets 1915.1 million NIS as of 2026-09-30 (Maya fund page, 'שווי נכסים').

fixed_management.notes: Fixed management fee as printed in the report: 0% of average annual net assets. Maya's fund page (https://maya.tase.co.il/he/funds/mutual-funds/5128905, read 2026-10-25) shows the same 'דמי ניהול' 0%. The manager committed to the ISA outline to raise its fees only on 1 January (ETF-16). Main prospectus published on Magna on 2025-08-07, reference 2025-03-058648 (not opened; Magna returns 403 to scripts), as the report states; the prospectus block cites this report.

variable_management.notes: p. 1 footnote 6: from 01.01.2026 the variable management fee is 0.2% a year of net assets (0.1% before; the report prints 0.1% as of 31.12.2025). Maya's fund page shows 0.2%. The mechanism works in both directions (ETF-14): the amount actually charged or paid depends on the gap to the tracking asset.

tracking_difference_12m.notes: Not printed as one number. The report's table 'תשואות, סטיות תקן ונתוני השוואה' (p. 7) prints the fund's return against its tracking asset: 2025 5.85% against 5.52% (NASDAQ 100 NTR 100%, US dollar 100%); 2024 25.86% against 25.86%; 2023 60.12% against 59.81%; 2022 -23.93% against -23.91%. The difference is not computed here (data-update rule). The ISA directive (ETF-07(e)) makes the manager publish the 12-month tracking difference every pricing day; this report points to the third-party page https://chart.bursagraph.co.il/funds.shtml?m=5 for it. That page (Funds Center by Guideline, run for the managers) states on the page 'אין להפיץ בכל דרך כלשהי ... את הנתונים המוצגים באתר', so its figures are not copied here (same position as CAT-43 for TASE lists); founder decision pending.

median_spread.notes: Not applicable: an open tracking fund is bought and redeemed at the unit price computed from net asset value, with no exchange spread. Load (שיעור הוספה): 0% on Maya's fund page and in the report (p. 1). The distributor may charge its own buy and sell commission (MF-26).

The fund takes its exposure mainly through derivatives (see REPLICATION in legal_form), so any dividend-withholding drag sits inside the instrument pricing and is not published as a rate.
